description: This Java class 'WidgetsBundleImportService' handles importing, preparing, saving, and comparing WidgetsBundle entities, including processing associated widget types within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing WidgetsBundle entities, managing their lifecycle and associated widget types during import process.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Assigns the tenant ID to the WidgetsBundle entity.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the WidgetsBundle entity for import, currently returns it unchanged.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the WidgetsBundle and its associated widget types, processing widget data and updating FQNs.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares the exported and existing WidgetsBundle data, returns a comparison result.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the WidgetsBundle entity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is WIDGETS_BUNDLE.
